confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge, not checked against live Koh Samui menus, bar prices or room listings. Restaurant and beer anchors are moderately reliable; accommodation is the most variable, since beach area and season drive rates. Cocktail and wine were set from the beer anchor at roughly 2.5 times beer because direct knowledge of current bar prices is weaker. FX uses the 14 Oct 2026 RBA observation as reported in search results; a later 15 Oct figure was not confirmed.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on typical 2026 price levels in Thai beach-resort destinations such as Phuket and Krabi beach areas, adjusted for Koh Samui's mix of beach resorts, guesthouses and local eateries; July treated as a shoulder period rather than peak season.
